author: kekwgame
quote:
This game is an insult to anyone who ever loved GTA.

The optimization is absolute garbage. Can't even maintain 30 FPS. The story is painfully linear, and the freedom is practically nonexistent. You can't buy houses, can't pick up hookers, can't go on dates. There's so much stuff you can't do. How the heck is this even GTA anymore?

And the story? Holy s***, it's the worst of the worst. What the eff happened to the original writers?

Jason spends the entire game getting pushed around and manipulated by Lucia, and it's painfully obvious the writers are trying to sell this toxic-ass relationship as something perfectly normal. It's honestly effin disgusting.

We waited 13 goddamn years for THIS?

Just stop calling it GTA already. Call it something else, because whatever the eff this is, it sure as hell ain't GTA.
